source_document: Xunta de Galicia, nota de prensa del 29 de agosto de 2022: «Eiras, en Vigo, del que se abastece la ciudad mayoritariamente»; Plan Hidrológico del Miño-Sil 2022–2027 (Mos, O Porriño, Salceda… take water from Eiras, transferred from Galicia-Costa)
notes: The Galicia-Costa plan (Anexo III, Apéndice 3.1) gives Vigo, Redondela and Moaña a 'Trasvase Cuenca Miño-Sil' and names no reservoir, while the Miño-Sil plan has its towns of the Vigo area drinking from Eiras, transferred from Galicia-Costa: the two plans describe the same shared Eiras system from each side. The Xunta says Vigo is supplied mainly from Eiras (O Casal plant); Redondela and Moaña are among the councils supplied from Eiras (Vigo press, 30 Aug 2022). The plan's Zamáns and aquifer rows for these units are kept.
